assertion.text: Erdős Problem #727: declared status 'open'. Formalized: yes. Let $k\geq 2$. Does\[(n+k)!^2 \mid (2n)!\]for infinitely many $n$? Current best: Erd\H{o}s \cite{Er68c} proved that if $a!b!\mid n!$ then $a+b\leq n+O(\log n)$. Prize: no. OEIS: A002503, A343507, A389396. Tags: factorials, number theory.
